## Problem to solve

Explain what is confusing or difficult to verify in **public** XRPL protocol behavior.

## Proposed public-scope solution

Describe a bounded, read-only tool, documentation improvement, or synthetic test. Do not include proprietary designs.

## Acceptance criteria

What test or example would demonstrate that the idea works? How can someone verify it independently?

## Public references

Link specifications, openly licensed research, or synthetic fixtures. Do not paste private reports or copied code.

## Publication check

- [ ] Proposed functionality does not sign, trade, or handle secrets.
- [ ] All descriptions and sources may lawfully be published.
- [ ] No internal project architecture or unreleased invention is disclosed.
